description: Frozen DRAMA baseline / Full FLASH scores reproducing tab:main_performance; no training or evaluation rerun.
selection_notes: 24 games use the current workbook loader common seeds and exclusions.
Krull replaces seed 710 with seed 2000; missing completed seed 2000 scores are recovered from W&B and local summaries.

Freeway uses 2030 and 2710. Seed 2040 has the same zero scores as 2030, but its baseline last log (2026-09-26 13:07 KST) is later than the paper update c6342e0 (2026-09-26 10:09 KST). This historical timing supports 2030 as the paper seed.
Mean, Median and Optimality Gap use rounded displayed game means; IQM pools raw per-seed HNS and trims floor(N/4) from both tails.
19 selected scores have no W&B evaluate/score and are verified only against the recorded Excel/CSV. Four of these also occur in classify_wandb_runs.py MANUAL_EVAL_RETURNS.
